item.tib: mkhas grub rin chen blo gros kyi rnam thar
item.coloph: de ltar bla ma'i rnam thar zur tsam bris pa 'di yang / mkhas 'dod nga rgyal dang / gcam bu'i ngos dga' dang phyogs 'dzin rang che gsum spangs shing / sgro skur med pa'i sgo nas/ gzhan gyis yang yang bskul ba'i ngor/ mdo gam lho yi ri khrod du snyigs dus kyi sprang btsun mu la rad Nas sbyar ba 'dis kyang / bla ma de nyid kyi yon tan bdag sogs bu slob rnams kyi rgyud la skyes nas/ bla ma de nyid kyi yon tan go 'phang thob par gyur cig mkha' la nyi ma shar ba la/ me khyer srin bus 'gran pa mtshar/ mkhan chen yul du byon pa'i tshe/ blun po'i phyogs 'dzin byol ba mthong / skye bo yon tan chung ba 'gas/ gcam bus sgro btags cal col smra/ des na byis pa 'thom 'gros can/ mkhas grub bla ma khyod kyis ni/ rnam dag lam la bkod du gsol/ khyod kyi rnam thar bshad pa la/ nyes gyur sgro skur mthol lo bshags/ 'di byas dge bas 'gro ba kun/ bla med bla ma'i sa thob shog mu tsug smar ro//
item.margin: mkhas grub rin blo'i rtogs brjod
